data.title: marble/: BRANDING.md — Prado pietra dura inlaid-tabletop direction (ultra-wide viewport)

data.body:
REVIEW (cold, fresh context) of 19afbec — marble/BRANDING.md + marble/index.html. VERDICT: PASS.

Verified:
- BRANDING.md meets all plan acceptance criteria: complete direction (3 laws + elegance mandate), palette tokens + computed WCAG contrast table (spot-checked alabaster/paragone ~16:1 — correct), tile cast list with real filenames + raw URL base + explicit gap warning (037-042, 046-047, 049-068, 087-088, 102-103), banned-tile list, kerf/fillet/arris joinery system, SVG pattern-fill inlay trick, type (Cinzel + Cormorant Garamond, %3B-encoded @import), ultra-wide layout (wings absorb width), motion (sheen only + reduced-motion), what-this-is-not table, page-application section honoring the root build contract (marble- id prefixes, keyframe prefix, isolation:isolate, no comma pseudo-classes), falsifiable 6-point closing test.
- Tile audit: every marbNNN in both files is outside the gap ranges and within 001-150. curl-checked 22 URLs (incl. all 12 the page loads and 10 tiles absent from the plan inventory: 006/007/009/033/071/084/091/126/142/150) — all HTTP 200.
- index.html matches the brief: palette tokens identical, fonts identical, full kerf+fillet+arris joinery on every seam, bilateral symmetry (mirrored wings via scaleX(-1)), marble-sheen 45s screen-blend + prefers-reduced-motion kill, :focus-visible double-fillet ring, tile casting matches Sec.10 exactly (022 moulding / 110 frieze / 093 reserves / 144 corners / 109 field / 044 cartouche / 034-133-113 wings / 107-115-129 pills). Head matches slop/index.html precedent verbatim (title/charset/viewport/description/robots noindex). Single-file page with no style.css matches the slop precedent; not mapped in sites.config.json (correct — integration is out of scope).
- SVG: all 5 ids prefixed marble-, every use/fill reference resolves, patterns reference valid tiles.
- External requests: Google Fonts + tile URLs only.
- Rendered at 2560x1440 and 780x1200: symmetric, fits without scroll at target width, reads as black slab in lapis+gold border, maker's mark renders once at bottom (verified by crop), stacks correctly at 780.

Minor notes (no rework needed):
1. Brief-internal tension: Sec.3 texture caveat says type sits ONLY on paragone tiles or basanite plaques, but Sec.10 (and closing-test item 4) casts alabaster labels on verde/lapis/rosso pill tiles. The page mitigates well (45% black multiply scrim under pill labels — scrims are sanctioned by Sec.3), and rendered contrast is fine, but the doc contradicts itself slightly.
2. index.html drops --t-lg (unused) and clamps --t-xl smaller than the brief (2-4rem vs 2.8-5.4rem) — pragmatic fit deviation.
3. Sec.10's 'book-matched' lapis frieze is not implemented (plain tiling, no scaleX alternation); imperceptible at frieze scale.
4. Maker's mark uses gilt-bright where brief says gilt (better contrast on lapis; fine). Plaque h2 is Cormorant 600 italic vs prose spec weight 500 (600 is imported by the brief's own @import, so intended).

None of these affect correctness or the elegance mandate. No inline fixes made. Meets acceptance criteria — moving to done.
